name: protodatabase
description: Prototype: protobuf messages as the single source of truth for a SQLite database.

scripts.gen: protoc --plugin=protoc-gen-es=../node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-es --es_out=gen --es_opt=target=ts -I ../services/proto -I proto planner/v1/planner.proto db/v1/database.proto && bun codegen.ts
